summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (every file has content+physical identity): FileIdentity carries the sha256 of the observed bytes plus the stat pair and a binary flag, captured under a two-stat bracket so the content identity always describes bytes that existed as a stable physical identity. Acceptance ② (unbounded/ambiguous scan cannot receipt): entries, logical-byte and wall-clock bounds each refuse as Unavailable — the error a receipt path treats as no-launch; ambiguity (a concurrent edit, a link) refuses as well. Acceptance ③ (foreign bytes preserved): pre-existing ignored paths, .git and ephemeral roots never enter the manifest, are never read-modified, and survive every capture/delta/CAS cycle verbatim — pinned byte-for-byte. P26.1 proven (all three bounds), P26.2 proven (link/junction rejection incl. Windows reparse points, out-of-scope by construction, ignored/ephemeral exclusion, CAS of every form through the P26A journal with dedup and refcounts, stale-content refusal), P26.3 proven (revalidate-every-identity refuses on a single foreign edit), P26.4 proven (post-exit double capture detects drift, holds None on a stable tree). Disclosed: the scanner is not yet wired into any launch path — P27 wraps processes with it and owns delta application/foreign-byte CAS restore; the concurrent-abort test requires an observed abort (size-alternating racer, 120 attempts) after its first cut passed vacuously. House 1104/1103/1 with only the declared plan_schema baseline; the conversation_engine race member appeared once, green in isolation, both numbers reported.
